clinical.table_comment: Medical history events containing symptoms, signs, and diagnoses entered on the GP system. Coded using Read codes, with prospective mapping to SNOMED CT codes since April 2018.

column_comments.clinical_adid: Description: Identifier that allows additional information to be retrieved for this event, when used in combination with pracid. A value of 0 signifies that there is no additional information associated with the event., Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Additional Details Identifier, Mapping: Link Additional Clinical Details table
column_comments.clinical_consid: Description: Identifier that allows information about the consultation to be retrieved, when used in combination with pracid, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Consultation Identifier, Mapping: Link Consultation table
column_comments.clinical_constype: Description: Code for the category of event recorded within the GP system (e.g. diagnosis or symptom), Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Consultation type, Mapping: Lookup SED
column_comments.clinical_enttype: Description: Identifier that represents the structured data area in Vision where the data was entered, Type: INTEGER, Format: 5, Field Name: Entity type, Mapping: Lookup Entity
column_comments.clinical_episode: Description: Episode type for a specific clinical event, Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Episode, Mapping: Lookup EPI
column_comments.clinical_eventdate: Description: Date associated with the event, as entered by the GP, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: Event Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.clinical_medcode: Description: CPRD unique code for the medical term selected by the GP, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Medical Code, Mapping: Lookup Medical Dictionary
column_comments.clinical_patid: Description: Encrypted unique identifier given to a patient in CPRD GOLD, Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: Patient Identifier, Mapping: None
column_comments.clinical_sctdescid: Description: When direct selection and entry of SNOMED CT terms is permitted this will contain the description ID of the selected term. This field will be NULL when map type = 4 (data entered as Read code), Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: SNOMED description ID, Mapping: None
column_comments.clinical_sctexpression: Description: A placeholder for SNOMED CT post-coordinated expressions. This is not supported in early phases of SNOMED implementation., Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: SNOMED Expression, Mapping: None
column_comments.clinical_sctid: Description: The mapped SNOMED CT Concept ID. mapping is conducted prior to data transfer and will vary by mapping version used., Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: SNOMED CT Concept ID3, Mapping: None
column_comments.clinical_sctisassured: Description: Indicates whether the Read to SNOMED mapping has been verified by a panel of physicians, Type: BOOLEAN, Format: 1, Field Name: SCT Is Assured, Mapping: None
column_comments.clinical_sctisindicative: Description: Reserved for use when systems write SNOMED CT terms natively. Used to indicate the reliability of the reverse SNOMED CT-Read map. Where SNOMED CT codes do not have a direct mapping to READ, the code Rz…00 will be utilised., Type: BOOLEAN, Format: 1, Field Name: SCT Is Indicative, Mapping: None
column_comments.clinical_sctmaptype: Description: Indicates the native encoding of the record in the Vision software (4 = term selected from Read dictionary, 5 = term selected from SNOMED CT), Type: INTEGER, Format: 1, Field Name: SNOMED mapping type, Mapping: None
column_comments.clinical_sctmapversion: Description: The version of the READ-SNOMED CT mapping table applied, Type: INTEGER, Format: 10, Field Name: SNOMED mapping Version, Mapping: None
column_comments.clinical_staffid: Description: Identifier of the practice staff member entering the data. A value of 0 indicates that the staffid is unknown, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Staff Identifier, Mapping: Link Staff table
column_comments.clinical_sysdate: Description: Date the event was entered into Vision, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: System Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY

consultation.table_comment: Information relating to the type of consultation entered by the GP, linked to events via the consultation identifier (consid).

column_comments.consultation_consid: Description: The consultation identifier linking events at the same consultation, when used in combination with pracid, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Consultation Identifier, Mapping: Link Event tables
column_comments.consultation_constype: Description: type of consultation (e.g. Surgery Consultation, Night Visit, Emergency etc.), Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Consultation type, Mapping: Lookup COT
column_comments.consultation_duration: Description: The length of time (minutes) between the opening, and closing of the consultation record, Type: INTEGER, Format: 10, Field Name: Duration, Mapping: None
column_comments.consultation_eventdate: Description: Date associated with the event, as entered by the GP, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: Event Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.consultation_patid: Description: Encrypted unique identifier given to a patient in CPRD GOLD, Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: Patient Identifier, Mapping: None
column_comments.consultation_staffid: Description: The identifier of the practice staff member entering the data. A value of 0 indicates that the staffid is unknown, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Staff Identifier, Mapping: Link Staff table
column_comments.consultation_sysdate: Description: Date the event was entered into Vision, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: System Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY

immunisation.table_comment: Details of immunisation records on the GP system.

column_comments.immunisation_batch: Description: Immunisation batch number, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Batch Number, Mapping: Lookup BatchNumber
column_comments.immunisation_compound: Description: Immunisation compound administered – may be a single or multicomponent preparation, e.g. MMR, Type: INTEGER, Format: 4, Field Name: Compound, Mapping: Lookup IMC
column_comments.immunisation_consid: Description: Identifier that allows information about the consultation to be retrieved, when used in combination with pracid, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Consultation Identifier, Mapping: Link Consultation table
column_comments.immunisation_constype: Description: Code for the category of event recorded within the GP system (e.g. intervention), Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Consultation type, Mapping: Lookup SED
column_comments.immunisation_eventdate: Description: Date associated with the event, as entered by the GP, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: Event Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.immunisation_immstype: Description: Individual components of an immunisation, e.g. Mumps, Rubella, Measles, Type: INTEGER, Format: 4, Field Name: type, Mapping: Lookup IMT
column_comments.immunisation_medcode: Description: CPRD unique code for the medical term selected by the GP, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Medical Code, Mapping: Lookup Medical Dictionary
column_comments.immunisation_method: Description: Route of administration for the immunisation, e.g. Oral, Intramuscular, Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Method, Mapping: Lookup IME
column_comments.immunisation_patid: Description: Encrypted unique identifier given to a patient in CPRD GOLD, Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: Patient Identifier, Mapping: None
column_comments.immunisation_reason: Description: Reason for administering the immunisation, e.g. Routine measure, Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Reason, Mapping: Lookup RIN
column_comments.immunisation_sctdescid: Description: When direct selection and entry of SNOMED CT terms is permitted this will contain the description ID of the selected term. This field will be NULL when map type = 4 (data entered as Read code), Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: SNOMED description ID, Mapping: None
column_comments.immunisation_sctexpression: Description: A placeholder for SNOMED CT post-coordinated expressions. This is not supported in early phases of SNOMED implementation., Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: SNOMED Expression, Mapping: None
column_comments.immunisation_sctid: Description: The mapped SNOMED CT Concept ID. mapping is conducted prior to data transfer and will vary by mapping version used., Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: SNOMED CT Concept ID3, Mapping: None
column_comments.immunisation_sctisassured: Description: Indicates whether the Read to SNOMED mapping has been verified by a panel of physicians., Type: BOOLEAN, Format: 1, Field Name: SCT Is Assured, Mapping: None
column_comments.immunisation_sctisindicative: Description: Reserved for use when systems write SNOMED CT terms natively. Used to indicate the reliability of the reverse SNOMED CT-Read map. Where SNOMED CT codes do not have a direct mapping to READ, the code Rz…00 will be utilised., Type: BOOLEAN, Format: 1, Field Name: SCT Is Indicative, Mapping: None
column_comments.immunisation_sctmaptype: Description: Indicates the native encoding of the record in the Vision software (4 = term selected from Read dictionary, 5= term selected from SNOMED CT), Type: INTEGER, Format: 1, Field Name: SNOMED mapping type, Mapping: None
column_comments.immunisation_sctmapversion: Description: The version of the READ-SNOMED CT mapping table applied, Type: INTEGER, Format: 10, Field Name: SNOMED mapping Version, Mapping: None
column_comments.immunisation_source: Description: Location where the immunisation was administered, e.g. In this practice, Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Source, Mapping: Lookup INP
column_comments.immunisation_staffid: Description: Identifier of the practice staff member entering the data. A value of 0 indicates that the staffid is unknown, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Staff Identifier, Mapping: Link Staff table
column_comments.immunisation_stage: Description: Stage of the immunisation given, e.g. 1, 2, B2, Type: INTEGER, Format: 2, Field Name: Stage, Mapping: Lookup IST
column_comments.immunisation_status: Description: Status of the immunisation e.g. Advised, Given, Refusal, Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Status, Mapping: Lookup IMM
column_comments.immunisation_sysdate: Description: Date the event was entered into Vision, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: System Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY

patient.table_comment: Basic patient demographics and registration details.

column_comments.patient_accept: Description: Flag to indicate whether the patient has met certain quality standards: 1 = acceptable, 0 = unacceptable, Type: INTEGER, Format: 1, Field Name: Acceptable Patient Flag, Mapping: Boolean
column_comments.patient_capsup: Description: Level of capitation supplement the patient has currently (e.g. low, medium, high), Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Capitation Supplement, Mapping: Lookup CAP
column_comments.patient_chsdate: Description: Date of registration with Child Health Surveillance, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: CHS Registration Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.patient_chsreg: Description: Value to indicate whether the patient is registered with Child Health Surveillance, Type: INTEGER, Format: 1, Field Name: CHS Registered, Mapping: Lookup Y_N
column_comments.patient_crd: Description: Date the patients current period of registration with the practice began (date of the first permanent record after the latest transferred out period). If there are no transferred out periods, the date is equal to frd, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: Current Registration Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.patient_deathdate: Description: Date of death of patient – derived using a CPRD algorithm, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: Death Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.patient_famnum: Description: Family ID number, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Family Number, Mapping: None
column_comments.patient_frd: Description: Date the patient first registered with the practice. If patient only has temporary records, the date is the first encounter with the practice. if patient has permanent records it is the date of the first permanent record (excluding preceding temporary records), Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: First Registration Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.patient_gender: Description: Patients gender, Type: INTEGER, Format: 1, Field Name: Patient Gender, Mapping: Lookup SEX
column_comments.patient_internal: Description: Number of internal transfer out periods, in the patients registration details, Type: INTEGER, Format: 2, Field Name: Internal Transfer, Mapping: None
column_comments.patient_marital: Description: Patients current marital status, Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Marital Status, Mapping: Lookup MAR
column_comments.patient_mob: Description: Patients month of birth (for those aged under 16). 0 indicates no month set, Type: INTEGER, Format: 2, Field Name: Birth Month, Mapping: None
column_comments.patient_patid: Description: Encrypted unique identifier given to a patient in CPRD GOLD, Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: Patient Identifier, Mapping: None
column_comments.patient_prescr: Description: type of prescribing exemption the patient has currently (e.g. medical / maternity), Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Prescription Exemption, Mapping: Lookup PEX
column_comments.patient_reggap: Description: Number of days missing in the patients registration details, Type: INTEGER, Format: 5, Field Name: Registration Gaps, Mapping: PAT_GAP2
column_comments.patient_regstat: Description: Status of registration detailing gaps and temporary patients, Type: INTEGER, Format: 2, Field Name: Registration Status, Mapping: PAT_STAT1
column_comments.patient_tod: Description: Date the patient transferred out of the practice, if relevant. Empty for patients who have not transferred out, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: Transfer Out Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.patient_toreason: Description: Reason the patient transferred out of the practice. Includes
column_comments.patient_vmid: Description: Old VM id for the patient when the practice was using the VAMP system, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: VAMP Identifier, Mapping: None
column_comments.patient_yob: Description: Patients year of birth. This is actual year of birth e.g. 1984, Type: INTEGER, Format: 4, Field Name: Birth Year, Mapping: None

practice.table_comment: Details of each practice, including region and collection information.

column_comments.practice_lcd: Description: Date of the last collection for the practice, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: Last Collection Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.practice_pracid: Description: Encrypted unique identifier given to a specific practice in CPRD GOLD, Type: INTEGER, Format: 5, Field Name: Practice identifier, Mapping: None
column_comments.practice_region: Description: Value to indicate where in the UK the practice is based. The region denotes the ONS Region for practices within England, and the country i.e. Wales, Scotland, or Northern Ireland for the rest, Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Region, Mapping: Lookup PRG
column_comments.practice_uts: Description: Date at which the practice data is deemed to be of research quality. Derived using a CPRD algorithm that primarily looks at practice death recording and gaps in the data, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: Up-to-standard date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY

referral.table_comment: Referral details recorded on the GP system, involving patient referrals to external care centres such as hospitals. Includes specialty and referral type.

column_comments.referral_consid: Description: Identifier that allows information about the consultation to be retrieved, when used in combination with pracid, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Consultation Identifier, Mapping: Link Consultation table
column_comments.referral_constype: Description: Code for the category of event recorded within the GP system (e.g. management or administration), Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Consultation type, Mapping: Lookup SED
column_comments.referral_eventdate: Description: Date associated with the event, as entered by the GP, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: Event Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.referral_fhsaspec: Description: Referral speciality according to the Family Health Services Authority (FHSA) classification, Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: FHSA Speciality, Mapping: Lookup SPE
column_comments.referral_inpatient: Description: Classification of the type of referral, e.g. Day case, In patient, Type: INTEGER, Format: 2, Field Name: In Patient, Mapping: Lookup RFT
column_comments.referral_medcode: Description: CPRD unique code for the medical term selected by the GP, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Medical Code, Mapping: Lookup Medical Dictionary
column_comments.referral_nhsspec: Description: Referral speciality according to the National Health Service (NHS) classification, Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: NHS Speciality, Mapping: Lookup DEP
column_comments.referral_patid: Description: Encrypted unique identifier given to a patient in CPRD GOLD, Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: Patient Identifier, Mapping: None
column_comments.referral_sctdescid: Description: When direct selection and entry of SNOMED CT terms is permitted this will contain the description ID of the selected term. column_comments.referral_sctisassured: Description: Indicates whether the Read to SNOMED mapping has been verified by a panel of physicians, Type: BOOLEAN, Format: 1, Field Name: SCT Is Assured, Mapping: None

column_comments.referral_sctmapversion: Description: The version of the READ-SNOMED CT mapping table applied, Type: INTEGER, Format: 10, Field Name: SNOMED mapping Version, Mapping: None
column_comments.referral_source: Description: Classification of the source of the referral e.g. GP, Self, Type: INTEGER, Format: 2, Field Name: Source, Mapping: Lookup SOU
column_comments.referral_staffid: Description: Identifier of the practice staff member entering the data. A value of 0 indicates that the staffid is unknown, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Staff Identifier, Mapping: Link Staff table
column_comments.referral_sysdate: Description: Date the event was entered into Vision, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: System Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.referral_urgency: Description: Classification of the urgency of the referral e.g. Routine, Urgent, Type: INTEGER, Format: 2, Field Name: Urgency, Mapping: Lookup URG

staff.table_comment: Practice staff details, with one record per member of staff.

column_comments.staff_gender: Description: Staff members gender, Type: INTEGER, Format: 1, Field Name: Staff Gender, Mapping: Lookup SEX
column_comments.staff_role: Description: Role of the member of staff who created the event, Type: INTEGER, Format: 3, Field Name: Staff Role, Mapping: Lookup ROL
column_comments.staff_staffid: Description: Encrypted unique identifier given to the practice staff member entering the data, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Staff Identifier, Mapping: None

therapy.table_comment: Details of all prescriptions (drugs and appliances) issued by the GP. Recorded using the Gemscript product code system.

column_comments.therapy_bnfcode: Description: Code representing the chapter & section from the British National Formulary for the product selected by GP, Type: INTEGER, Format: 5, Field Name: BNF Code, Mapping: Lookup BNFCodes
column_comments.therapy_consid: Description: Identifier that allows information about the consultation to be retrieved, when used in combination with pracid, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Consultation Identifier, Mapping: Link Consultation table
column_comments.therapy_dosageid: Description: Identifier that allows dosage information on the event to be retrieved. Use the Common Dosages Lookup to obtain the anonymised dosage text and extracted numerical information such as daily dose., Type: TEXT, Format: 64, Field Name: Dosage Identifier, Mapping: Lookup Common Dosages
column_comments.therapy_drugdmd: Description: The mapped drug DMD code, Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: DMD Code, Mapping: None
column_comments.therapy_eventdate: Description: Date associated with the event, as entered by the GP, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: Event Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
column_comments.therapy_issueseq: Description: Number to indicate whether the event is associated with a repeat schedule. Value of 0 implies the event is not part of a repeat prescription. A value ≥ 1 denotes the issue number for the prescription within a repeat schedule, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Issue Sequence Number, Mapping: None
column_comments.therapy_numdays: Description: Number of treatment days prescribed for a specific therapy event, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Number of Days, Mapping: None
column_comments.therapy_numpacks: Description: Number of individual product packs prescribed for a specific therapy event, Type: INTEGER, Format: 8, Field Name: Number of Packs, Mapping: None
column_comments.therapy_packtype: Description: Pack size or type of the prescribed product, Type: INTEGER, Format: 10, Field Name: Pack type, Mapping: Lookup Packtype
column_comments.therapy_patid: Description: Encrypted unique identifier given to a patient in CPRD GOLD, Type: TEXT, Format: 20, Field Name: Patient Identifier, Mapping: None
column_comments.therapy_prn: Description: Indicates if the prescription is to be supplied as required. Field available to GPs from end 2020., Type: BOOLEAN, Format: 1, Field Name: As Required, Mapping: None
column_comments.therapy_prodcode: Description: CPRD unique code for the treatment selected by the GP, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Product Code, Mapping: Lookup Product Dictionary
column_comments.therapy_qty: Description: Total quantity entered by the GP for the prescribed product, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Total Quantity, Mapping: None
column_comments.therapy_staffid: Description: Identifier of the practice staff member entering the data. A value of 0 indicates that the staffid is unknown, Type: INTEGER, Format: 20, Field Name: Staff Identifier, Mapping: Link Staff table
column_comments.therapy_sysdate: Description: Date the event was entered into Vision, Type: DATE, Format: DD/MM/YYYY, Field Name: System Date, Mapping: DD/MM/YYYY
